message: うまい

name: Paqy
message: 「Your place?」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way she'd be here, right? That's why I figured coming here would just be a waste of time」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't afford to waste time in a place like--」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's wrong?」
I quietly opened the front door.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, your shoes--mmph-mmph」
While covering Paqy's mouth, I crept inside.
Light was leaking from the direction of the kitchen.
I could hear the sound of soba being made. I could smell the aroma.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, eh!? S-Synn!?」
Thank goodness. I thought I'd never see her again.
I wanted to see her. More than anyone else, I wanted to see Nanaka.
My chest was so full that I couldn't find the words.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-wh-wh-why are you here!?」
The words that finally came out sounded foolish even to me.

name: Synn
message: 「This is my house」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, ah, r-right, of course it is」

name: Synn
message: 「R-right」

name: Synn
message: 「......Go ahead」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-what?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it okay... to just leave the dough sitting there?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Oh, i-it's fine! It won't dry out that easily」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right... Come to think of it, yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! You know how it is」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I knew」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Umm... just have a seat for now, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'll whip it up right away, so just wait」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, sure」
W-What is going on here?
Why is Nanaka making soba noodles in the middle of the night!?
Actually, that's a good question too, but isn't why she's making it at my place an even bigger question!?
Well, none of that matters right now, I guess.
Because I finally found Nanaka.

name: Paqy
message: 「Mmph, mmmph, mmph」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong, Paqy? You look pale」

name: Paqy
message: 「Mmmgh, mmmgh」

name: Synn
message: 「You look like you're about to suffocate」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh」
I let go of Paqy's mouth.

name: Paqy
message: 「Wheeze, wheeze. Thought I was gonna die」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks for waiting! One order, coming right up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks delicious」
The rich aroma of freshly made soba fills the kitchen.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I―I made a little too much, so eat it all if you can! Anyway, I'll just―」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaaaah! Wait!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah」
Without thinking, I grabbed Nanaka's wrist as she tried to slip away.

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uhh, you know, that thing! Well, it's that! Just wait, anyway, wait!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, no, I can't, because I'm」
If I let her leave now, I'll never see Nanaka again. That's how it feels.

name: Synn
message: 「T-There's plenty, so eat with me! Together!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, but」

name: Synn
message: 「Eat with me. Please」

name: Synn
message: 「Please」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...W-Well... i-if it's just to eat」
I let go of her hand only after making sure Nanaka has taken a seat.
I take out the colander and divide up the soba.
I put grated daikon and wasabi onto three small plates.
The sharp sting of the wasabi hits my nose.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Something wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not brewed from used tea leaves!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope」
I pour piping-hot tea. And made from proper tea leaves, at that.
I press my hands together and bow my head.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the meal」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Thanks for the meal」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm totally starving」
The clock has passed 2:30 AM.
We sit facing each other at the cramped kitchen table and eat our soba.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your lines are always the same. Well, the taste is always the same too, so I guess it can't be helped.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's really delicious, really!」
It really did taste the same as always, and yet, it tasted better than ever.

name: Paqy
message: 「So damn good. Especially after walking all over Ryuusei Town! Hits different!」

name: Synn
message: 「You were just tagging along with me, weren't you」

name: Paqy
message: 「I got mentally hungry, man」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why were you walking around so much--」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. You haven't eaten at all. The noodles are gonna get soggy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I know!」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」
I see.
All this time, every single day, I've been eating food this delicious.
I took it completely for granted.
Even though it was never something to take for granted.
If things had changed between Nanaka and me, there was a chance I'd never get to eat this again.

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's no different from usual...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's delicious」
Nanaka kept making food this good, all for my sake.
For a dense blockhead like me who only ever gave the exact same reaction every single time.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seriously... you're always the same...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry」
For me. Just for me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry...? You don't have anything to apologize for, you're complimenting me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, Synn, why are you crying?!」
I bring a hand to my eyes, and sure enough, my fingertips come away wet with lukewarm moisture.

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn, piling on that much wasabi is real unrefined. You're gonna ruin the flavor of the soba」

name: Paqy
message: 「You shouldn't glob wasabi into the dipping sauce either」

name: Synn
message: 「...It's because it's so good」
Seriously. There were so many things I hadn't noticed.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You keep saying that...」
Why Nanaka invited me onto the boat that day.
Why Nanaka always stayed by my side.
Why Nanaka's soba tastes so good.
Why she kept making soba for me to eat.
I'm sure there are still plenty of things I haven't noticed even now. Probably.
But I feel like I finally realized what matters most.
I wiped away my tears.

name: Synn
message: 「Because it's really delicious.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I get it already!」
We fell silent.
And then, we quietly finished off the soba.
I carefully ate down to the very last strand left on the bamboo tray.
Soba-yu is brought out.
I drink it gratefully.
It was past 3:00 AM.

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for the meal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Phew. Thanks for the grub.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... I'll be heading out then...」
Nanaka stands up from her seat.

name: Synn
message: 「It was delicious. Truly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see... I'm glad...」
I took a deep breath in and let it out.
To her back as she started walking out of the kitchen without looking back at me,

name: Synn
message: 「From now on, too, I want to keep eating the soba you make, Nanaka.」
Her steps, just about to leave, came to a halt.

name: Synn
message: 「I want to eat it forever. I want to spend my time together with you, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-That kind of sounds like a proposal, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it does.」
That was my answer to Nanaka, who had kept waiting for me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Right? Honestly, you're so thoughtless, Synn. Ahaha.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if that's true, I don't care」
Nanaka won't turn around to look at me.
I can't see what kind of face she's making.

name: Nanaka
message: 「How can you…… say something like that…… so easily?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because it's you, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because it's you. It's just like when you invited me to travel around the world」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You remembered that……?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because it was you, I was able to say yes」

name: Nanaka
message: 「……Someone like me is no good. I turned out to be a demon, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「When I thought I might never see you again. My chest hurt. I felt so sad」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't understand, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm saying this because I do understand, because I realized it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Say that kind of stuff to a human girl, okay? I'm no good. Not at all」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not tr――」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's laughable, isn't it? Even though I'm a demon. Thinking I was just a completely normal human up until now」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm also――」
I'm the Demon Lord too. I started to say it, then stopped.
Somehow, that felt wrong.

name: Nanaka
message: 「But believe me on this one thing. Well, I guess you can't believe anything a liar who hid being a demon says, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even I didn't know. This is the truth. I wasn't trying to deceive you, Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, but I guess that still counts as deceiving you. In the end. Aah, I really am a liar」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A little while ago, you see. I started having dreams where I wasn't myself」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I just thought it was a weird, strangely persistent dream. I mean, it was just a dream, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But, well. Since it was so persistent, it started creeping me out more and more. I even got scared to go to sleep」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then. When I stayed over at the academy or at Sacchin's place, I didn't have them, so」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But I started seeing them at Sacchin's place too... and when I woke up in the morning, I'd turned into a Demon... It calmed down right away, so Sacchin didn't notice, though」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's why you went to Misasagi-senpai's house?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. Otherwise I never would've stayed at someone like that's place... Even so, I ended up turning anyway, and Bubuzuke saw me」
Melilot-san was one step too late.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, I thought as long as Synn didn't find out, it'd be fine. As long as you didn't find out, things would somehow work out. Ahaha. Pretty shameless of me, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I'm a Demon, so maybe being shameless is only natural」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even this morning, you know. I finally made it through without having any dreams, so I actually thought everything was going to go smoothly」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But there's no way something like that could ever work out, right? Lying and hiding things--there's no way that could go well」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My eyes met Sengenin-sensei's... and I felt something being dragged out from deep inside my body... and then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The rest is just what you saw. Though I'm sure Bubuzuke spilled the beans just for kicks」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, scratch that. Bubuzuke might be a jerk, but he wouldn't do something like that. I know that much. Ahaha. Guess I'm the bigger jerk after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that all?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now you get it, right? That I can't be with you anymore」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean, why... Weren't you listening?」

name: Synn
message: 「I heard everything. So?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you heard me, then you understand, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why not! Because I'm a Demon!」
I stood up from my seat.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Nanaka, look at me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the Student Council President and a member of the Crusaders! There's no way we can be together!」
I step closer to her back.

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan is with the Student Council too, isn't she」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because she isn't hiding anything! My situation is totally different!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Nanaka, look at me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, I ran away! Leaving everyone behind to fight someone as strong as Sengenin-sensei all by myself! I'm sure they think I'm a traitor!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody thinks that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course they do!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not your fault, Nanaka. Anyone would freak out if they suddenly turned into something like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But……」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Look at me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nobody's gonna believe a girl who turned into a demon」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that why you didn't tell Sacchin either?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because if she saw eyes glowing red like this, of course she'd be scared!」
I get it.
Even I couldn't become a complete Demon Lord because I was scared of being found out--scared of Nanaka finding out.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nobody's ever gonna believe me」

name: Synn
message: 「I believe you. Everything you just told me, too. You're not a liar, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I was hiding it, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「If I didn't believe you, why would I be here?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because that's just the kind of guy you are, Synn. You'd go looking for anyone. Even a childhood friend who's a traitor」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, maybe I would go looking for anyone. But tonight, the one I was looking for was you, Nanaka」
Nanaka's shoulders were trembling.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why…… do you have to say something so smooth right now」

name: Synn
message: 「It's the truth」
Her trembling back looked so small.

name: Synn
message: 「What if. Just what if. Even though it's impossible, even if everyone in the world didn't believe your story」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll be the one who believes you, Nanaka. Even if everyone in the Student Council becomes your enemy. Even if the whole world becomes your enemy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Liar……」
I gently wrapped my arms around Nanaka from behind.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not lying」
In my arms, her trembling gradually subsided.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if it's a lie... I don't care...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's the truth」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I thought about buying the most expensive ticket... and running away somewhere far... Anywhere was fine as long as it was far...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So... I made it all the way to the station...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But then, out of nowhere. I remembered I'd left a bunch of buckwheat flour here... and thought about how you can't make soba on your own, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since it's the Holy Night Festival... I figured you'd be staying overnight today... and that we wouldn't run into each other...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So... I thought I'd make some soba for you one last time... Even though it'd probably get all soggy by the time you got back... I still wanted to...」
Nanaka's hand was placed over mine.
It was warm.

name: Synn
message: 「Nope」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I was planning to leave somewhere right after making it... and then you showed up...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then... well... I started thinking, maybe it's fine if we eat together, since I made so much anyway... and it'd be a waste...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope」
Nanaka turned around and looked at me.
Her eyes were wet with tears.
My reflection wavered inside them.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I was going to leave somewhere once we finished eating... but you had to go and say all those sweet things...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You said such really, really sweet things... now I don't know what to do... Seriously... I'm being so clingy it's pathetic... even though I'd already given up」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Be troubled. And you don't have to give up」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that really okay...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. It's okay」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I see... It's okay, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「Can I kiss you? I just kind of got in the mood for it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sure. If it's you, anytime」

name: Synn
message: 「This time, it's not an accident」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...The last one wasn't an accident either」
We draw closer.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry for calling it an accident」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine. It's fine. Don't worry about that anymore. I'm the one who said it first, after all...」
A soft, warm sensation presses against my lips.
My breath stops. Time stops.
We're kissing.
It tastes just a little bit like soba broth.
After a stretch of time that felt both terribly long and like a mere instant.
Without either of us pulling away first, our lips part.

name: Nanaka
message: 「We did it」

name: Synn
message: 「We sure did」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It wasn't an accident this time, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't an accident this time」
We looked at each other and laughed just a little.

name: Paqy
message: 「Ahem, cough, cough」
We hurriedly jumped apart.

name: Paqy
message: 「What's with the reaction now? Yours truly has been here the whole time. I was just being considerate for ya!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So what's with you all of a sudden?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「December 24th, 4:23 and 28 seconds. Margin of error's within two minutes」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah! That's right, Synn, this is bad!」

name: Synn
message: 「There's less than an hour left, yeah... What's bad?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Re-Crea, obviously! Actually, why am I the one remembering this before you?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah! That's right! It's almost time for Re-Crea!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn, did you seriously forget? Yours truly figured you were gonna say we needed the power of soba to fight Re-Crea, and」

name: Paqy
message: 「you were just keeping quiet so Soba wouldn't get bent out of shape thinking she's not needed unless there's a fight」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehehe, I see, so that's how it is」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, shall we go do the final bit of work to get the Holy Night Festival started!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」
